paper_metadata.title: A Novel Low-Voltage Content-Addressable-Memory (CAM) Cell with a Fast Tag-Compare Capability Using Partially Depleted (PD) SOI CMOS Dynamic-Threshold (DTMOS) Techniques
paper_metadata.abstract: This paper reports a novel low-voltage content-addressable-memory (CAM) cell with a fast tag-compare capability using partially depleted (PD) SOI CMOS dynamic-threshold (DTMOS) techniques. With two auxiliary pass transistors to dynamically control the bodies of transistors in the tag-compare portion of CAM cell, this SOI CAM cell has a fast tag-compare capability at a low supply voltage of 0.7 V as verified by the results from the two-dimensional semiconductor device simulation program MEDICI.
